sentences.en: It's very warm. Shall I turn on the air conditioner?
sentences.zh: 天气很热。我开不开空调?

sentences.en: I can't do without an air conditioner in the summer.
sentences.zh: 夏天没有空调我就没法过。

sentences.en: Which air conditioner do you think is the most efficient?
sentences.zh: 你认为哪种空调最省电?

senses.zh: 护发素，护发剂; 柔顺剂，柔软剂
